items.summary: Hilltop Securities Inc. (HilltopSecurities) celebrated its 80 th Anniversary on April 2, 2026, marking a legacy of success and innovation that dates back to the post-World War II era. The Company acquired a senior housing and skilled nursing campus located in Southern California, comprising 120 licensed skilled nursing beds and 273 senior housing units.
